what_this_is: Preregistered pass criteria for tier 2. Committed before the run whose
numbers they judge. Every band below is taken from an existing measured
result in docs/, cited in `evidence`, widened only by the Monte Carlo
error of the tier 2 design (57,000 null observations per cell: 0.0009 on
a 0.05 rate, 0.004 on a 0.95 coverage). Nothing here was chosen after
seeing a tier 2 number. If a band has to move, move it in a commit of its

null_calibration._establishes: Under a true null the interval covers at its nominal rate and the test has its nominal size. This is the single most load-bearing claim a GWAS method makes.

coverage95.evidence: docs/BP2_lumpy_phenotypes.md section 2 measures 0.9491-0.9508 for OLS across every phenotype shape tested and 0.9433-0.9438 for jackknife GLS on smooth traits; docs/OLS_VS_GLS.md gives 0.9499 for both under the null at 20,000 reps.

typeI_0.05.evidence: docs/MEAN_VARIANCE_ARTEFACT.md section 6: 0.0488-0.0503 over six estimator/scale cells at 68,000 null tests each.

typeI_1e-3_ratio.evidence: docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md section 7: actual/nominal 1.042 (location) and 1.074 (scale) at p = 1e-3 after the t-reference fix.

sd_z_abs_dev.evidence: docs/MEAN_VARIANCE_ARTEFACT.md section 6 reports sd(z) 0.9955-1.0016 on the null class.

Q_rejection_0.05.evidence: Q is a lack-of-fit statistic with a calibrated reference; under a correctly specified model on null variants it should reject at nominal.

alternative._establishes: Under a real distributional effect the estimator still covers its own population estimand, and its reported standard error still describes its actual variability.

coverage95_theta_pop.evidence: docs/OLS_VS_GLS.md: 0.9409/0.9373 (OLS/GLS) under a true scale effect and 0.9406/0.9409 under a mixed one; docs/FINDINGS_pooled_dispersion.md section 3 shows the pooled covariance sagging further at rare MAF, to 0.9114 at MAF 0.05 and Z = 30. The floors are set below the worst documented value so that only a NEW failure trips them.

abs_bias_over_sd.evidence: docs/OLS_VS_GLS.md binned by lack of fit: |bias| 0.021-0.051 empirical sd for OLS where the model fits, 0.128 for GLS where it does not.

se_over_empirical_sd.evidence: docs/FINDINGS_pooled_dispersion.md section 4: mean_se/emp_sd 0.898-1.003 across arms; the jackknife at B = 1000 with GLS is the low end.

tournament._establishes: Both halves: the true model is selected, AND the models that cannot represent the truth are rejected. A tournament that only ever confirms the truth has not been tested.
tournament.evidence: No prior measurement exists for the rejection half. The selection floor is set from docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md section 4, which measures raw-Q BIC selecting the true additive model 59 per cent of the time; 0.80 is on SPANNING models (the truth or a superset of it), which is the weaker and better-posed question.

pins._establishes: Four established failure modes. The BLOCKING half of each is that the default, recommended path stays sound; the presence of the defect on a non-default path is recorded and, where the evidence base says it must be fixed, raised as advisory.

false_vqtl.evidence: docs/FINDINGS_pooled_dispersion.md section 5: flagging at G >= 0.2 holds the false-dispersion rate within 2x nominal, is monotone in G across every MAF, N and effect size tested, and correctly passes the MAF 0.50 / Z_mu 73.9 cell. The blocking criterion is that the guard does not MISS: no bucket the guard calls clean may be inflated.

ties_gls.evidence: docs/BP2_lumpy_phenotypes.md section 2: on round_0p50 the GLS Type-I is 0.0000 and coverage 0.9973 while OLS is 0.9502 / 0.0498. OLS staying correct is what blocks; the GLS collapse is recorded.

ceiling_censoring.evidence: docs/BP2_lumpy_phenotypes.md section 2: ceil_20 under GLS rejects at 4.90x nominal at alpha = 1e-4 and 270x at 1e-6, while OLS is unaffected. This is the only anti-conservative failure BP2 found.

loco_scale.evidence: docs/LOCO_SCALE.md. Tested in tier 1 as a refusal (T1.REF.loco_scale_mismatch): a Sigma_0 built under a different --loco-scale than the scan must stop the run, because the damage is invisible downstream (log_bmi shape effects attenuated 2.2x with SEs inflated 2.2x).
